newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa to provide 100 bln yen support to unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa to provide 100 bln yen support to unit - paper.

text.p: Daiwa Securities Co Ltd will provide financial support of about 100 billion yen to a finance affiliate in the year to March 31, 1997, which would reduce Daiwa's parent net profit to nil in 1996/97, a Japanese newspaper said.

The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Daiwa was expected to post a parent current profit of 50 billion yen for 1996/97 and was also expected to record an extraordinary profit of about 50 billion yen from sales of stocks in its 1996/97 parent earnings.
Daiwa's finance affiliate is suffering due to bad loans of about 100 billion yen, the newspaper said.
A Daiwa spokesman said he could not immediately comment on the report.
